description: Source PHP file for the 'Reset / Restore Gateway' web interface, including HTML, JavaScript, and PHP includes. It provides functionalities for resetting the gateway, Wi-Fi modules, restoring defaults, and other configuration actions with user confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends reset or restore commands to the server and handles UI updates based on response.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks periodically if the system has rebooted and redirects to login page upon success.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends battery-related information to the server.
